response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN sc.gbsize END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN sc.spanmin END), 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY si.healtheval), avgt AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gpm FROM per) SELECT per.status, per.total_scans, per.gb_per_min, per.gb_per_min - avgt.avg_gpm AS excess_over_average FROM per CROSS JOIN avgt WHERE per.gb_per_min > avgt.avg_gpm

assumptions.assumption: GB per minute for a status is total gbsize divided by total spanmin (ratio of sums), using only scans where both gbsize and spanmin are non-null.
total scans is the sum of scancount over all matched scans in the status, including scans with missing gbsize or spanmin.
The average is the unweighted mean of the per-status GB per minute values over statuses with a non-null figure. Scans whose site has a NULL healtheval form their own group and count as a status.

alternatives.interpretation: GB per minute for a status is the average of each scan's own gbsize/spanmin ratio (scans with non-null values and spanmin > 0), rather than a ratio of sums.
alternatives.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans, AVG(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 THEN sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin END) AS gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY si.healtheval), avgt AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gpm FROM per) SELECT per.status, per.total_scans, per.gb_per_min, per.gb_per_min - avgt.avg_gpm AS excess_over_average FROM per CROSS JOIN avgt WHERE per.gb_per_min > avgt.avg_gpm
